title: Lord Banehollow
wikitext:
{{npcbox | image = Banehollow.jpg | name = Lord Banehollow | gender = Male | race = Nathrezim | character = [[Dreadlord]] | affiliation = [[Burning Legion]], the [[Jaedenar]] | faction = [[Burning Legion]], [[Shadow Council]] | occupation = Leader of the current Inner Circle | status = Alive | relatives = Hel'nurath (rival)}}} [[Lord Banehollow]] is a level 59 [[quest giver]] located in [[Shadow Hold]] in the [[contested]] territory of [[Felwood]]. He is an [[elite]] [[Dreadlord]], and the leader of [[Jaedenar]], the seat of the [[Shadow Council]]. He is guarded by a wide variety of warlocks, demons, and his personal attendant [[Ur'dan]]. Any [[Warlock]] seeking to steal a [[Dreadsteed]] must deal with Banehollow by first drinking a [[Shadowy Potion]]. He assists and directs you in stealing the steed from a rival of his, [[Lord Hel'nurath]] of [[Xoroth]]. "Banehollow" is also one of the random names given to the Dreadlord hero in Warcraft III.
